body: macOS M13, M15 and the live accessibility sweep.U+000AU+000AHarness fact: the probe keeps ONE storage slot; `scenario?name=X` with a different name wipes it (ProbeStorage.begin deletes data/). M14's switch to scenario "long" erased the e2e journal, so the first Delete all reported "Deleted 0 days and 0 entries" correctly.U+000AU+002D M13 Delete all: pass on fresh data (2 notes + mood): "Delete everything?" confirm, notice "Deleted 1 days and 2 entries.", Today empty, streak 0 (m13_deleted_notice.png, m13_today_empty.png). Cosmetic "1 days".U+000AU+002D M15 plain app (bundle dev.satanshumishra.fieldNotes.plain, own container; the owner's dev.satanshumishra.fieldNotes container untouched): pass. Driven by AX presses (accessibility on via the env switch) plus pid-scoped keys (pinp U+003Cpid> type/key), under a plain-app copy of probe_guard (bundle swapped, ping abort disabled). Note typed and saved, persisted across quit and relaunch (m15_plain_saved.png, m15_plain_relaunch.png). Deleting an entry from the viewer asks "Delete this entry?" and works.U+000AU+002D Not done on the plain app: spell check and the reminder. Settings is not exposed to AX (below) and Tab gives no visible focus ring, so the switches could not be reached blind. Left as owner hand checks.U+000AU+000ALive macOS AX sweep of the plain app (dumps in results/macos/a11y/*.txt, shots results/macos/e2e/a11y_*.png):U+000AU+002D Blocks for VoiceOver users: the Settings screen is absent from the AX tree. Opening Settings from Today leaves Today's nodes in the tree; from Search, a stale Search result node remains; no Settings control appears. Leaving Settings restores a correct tree. Flutter's own semantics tree has every Settings row (probe `semantics`), so the loss is between Flutter and macOS, as with the month picker. Settings is a normal ShellContent destination (lib/app/shell/shell_content.dart), so the trigger is inside SettingsScreen (unverified which widget).U+000AU+002D Hurts: month picker invisible in AX when open (recorded earlier).U+000AU+002D Hurts: sidebar Today/Calendar/Garden/Search are AXStaticText with a Press action, not buttons or tabs, with no selected state; "Dismiss mood picker" and "Dismiss day detail" are full-window StaticText with Press.U+000AU+002D Hurts: text fields carry no label on macOS: the Search field and the note editor are AXTextField with no title, description or placeholder (AX attribute list has only Role, Value, RoleDescription), though Flutter labels them "Search your days" and "Note". Likely Flutter-level (unverified against a stock labelled TextField).U+000AU+002D Hurts (keyboard): Escape does not close the voice recorder (twice); Close does. Escape closes the viewer, day sheet and month picker.U+000AU+002D Hurts (keyboard): no visible focus indicator after Tab on Settings (m15_tab1.png).U+000AU+002D Pass: composer toolbar buttons, Cancel/Save, Add memory, mood tiles, viewer Close/Edit note/Delete entry, to-do CheckBox with value, calendar "Day 27, today, has entries", week garden "Sun, no mood", recorder Close/Start recording are all labelled with correct roles.
